newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian shares higher on Dow rise, seen up.
newsitem.headline: Russian shares higher on Dow rise, seen up.

text.p: Leading Russian shares opened higher on Wednesday following Tuesday's gains on Wall Street and traders said the market would rise further during the day.

"I think that the market will probably rise today, because the Dow Jones was up yesterday and I think we should move into line with it today," said Alexander Pankov, a trader at CentreInvest Securities.
The Russian Trading System 23-share index edged up to 292.24 at the opening after closing at 291.41 on Tuesday.

National power utility and market benchmark UES EESR.RTS rose to $0.2170 at 0815 GMT from Tuesday's closing $0.2090 and oil company Surgutneftegaz SNGS.RTS also nosed higher to $0.732 from $0.708 on Tuesday.
But traders said volumes were too low to predict significant market movement during the day.
"If people see Western buying orders start to come in then Russian players will also start buying," said Pankov.
But one said the market was simply adjusting after low levels last week.

"I think the market will be up about two to three percent today, but this is the second day the market has gone up after being down for two or three days. It's just a technical correction," said Prospekt trader Andrei Ippolitov.
